rv3-000119.passageAppend: The class later compared its survey with a second survey that asked only a yes-or-no question about repair. The simple survey produced stronger opinions, while the detailed survey produced more comments about conditions and funding. Aki realized that asking people to choose after showing costs and alternatives did not merely collect an existing opinion; it sometimes changed or refined that opinion. Several residents who first supported full repair moved toward partial repair when they saw the maintenance estimate, while others became more supportive after learning how much local businesses used the square. The students concluded that public consultation should not be treated as a machine for measuring fixed preferences. It can also be a process in which people learn, compare values, and reconsider priorities while considering costs, alternatives, and consequences. It also showed them that survey design can shape the conversation itself.
rv3-000119.translationAppend: クラスは、修理の賛否だけを尋ねる単純なアンケートとも結果を比べました。単純な質問では強い賛否が出やすい一方、費用や選択肢を示した詳しい調査では条件や資金についての意見が多くなりました。秋は、アンケートは固定した意見を測るだけではなく、情報を得ることで人の考えが変わったり具体化したりする場合があると気づきました。最初は全面修理を支持した人が維持費を見て部分修理へ変わる一方、商店が広場をよく利用していると知って修理への支持を強める人もいました。住民参加は単なる意見の集計ではなく、費用や選択肢、結果を考えながら価値を比較し、優先順位を見直す過程にもなります。また、質問の作り方そのものが議論の形を変えることも学びました。

rv3-000120.passageAppend: The school also examined whether removing bells changed how teachers used lesson time. Some teachers became better at planning endings because they could no longer rely on a sound to stop them. Others found themselves checking the clock too often, especially during discussion activities. The staff shared practical strategies, such as placing a small timer where only the teacher could see it or assigning a student timekeeper during group work. These adjustments showed that removing one external signal did not remove the need for coordination; it shifted that responsibility to other cues, habits, and people. The principal therefore warned against describing the experiment as a move from control to complete freedom. Students and teachers still needed structure, but they could decide which forms of structure were useful. That distinction helped the school improve the system instead of judging the idea by the first week of results.
rv3-000120.translationAppend: 学校は、チャイムをなくすことで教師の時間の使い方がどう変わるかも調べました。終了の音に頼れなくなったことで、授業の終わり方を上手に計画するようになった教師もいれば、話し合い活動中に時計を何度も確認するようになった教師もいました。そこで、教師だけが見える小さなタイマーや、グループ活動で生徒の時間係を置く方法などを共有しました。外部の合図を一つなくしても、時間調整そのものが不要になるわけではなく、その責任が別の合図、習慣、人へ移るだけだと分かりました。校長は、この実験を『管理から完全な自由へ』という単純な変化として捉えるべきではないと説明しました。必要な構造は残しながら、どんな形が役立つかを選べることが重要だったのです。

rv3-000121.passageAppend: The project also changed how kitchen staff discussed unpopular food. Instead of saying that students simply disliked a dish, they began asking whether the problem involved taste, texture, temperature, portion size, or unfamiliarity. Those questions led to smaller and more focused experiments. One soup was served in smaller bowls because students often wanted only a taste. A vegetable side dish was placed earlier in the serving line so it was easier to notice before trays became full. Another recipe was left unchanged after surveys showed that a vocal minority disliked it but most students ate it. Mari learned that a complaint can be real without representing everyone. By separating different possible causes, the school avoided making one large change based on a single impression. None of the improvements was dramatic by itself, but together they reduced one source of misunderstanding.
rv3-000121.translationAppend: この活動によって、厨房でも『残り物が多い料理＝生徒が嫌いな料理』とすぐ決めつけなくなりました。味、食感、温度、量、見慣れなさなど、別々の原因を考えるようになったのです。あるスープは少量だけ試したい生徒が多いため小さな器にし、野菜のおかずはトレーがいっぱいになる前に目に入りやすい位置へ移しました。別の料理は、一部の強い不満はあっても多くの生徒が食べていることが調査で分かり、変更しませんでした。真理は、一つの不満が本物であっても全員を代表するとは限らないと学びました。原因を分けて考えることで、印象だけをもとに大きく変更することを避けられました。個々の工夫は小さくても、合わせることで誤解の原因を一つずつ減らすことができました。

rv3-000122.passageAppend: The club later faced a harder case when translating a phrase connected with religious custom. A one-sentence English explanation could not carry every historical and emotional meaning of the original term. The students therefore placed a short practical explanation in the main guide and linked to a longer note for readers who wanted more background. Yuto realized that communication design includes not only what information to give, but also when and how much to give. Too much explanation in the main text could hide the action a visitor needed to take, while too little could make the custom seem meaningless. The club also created a decision log for difficult translations, recording the choice they made and why. New members could then understand earlier reasoning instead of starting every debate again. The record also helped reviewers distinguish deliberate choices from accidental inconsistency, which improved both quality control and confidence in later revisions. That made future editing faster and more consistent across different projects.
rv3-000122.translationAppend: 宗教的な習慣に関わる表現では、一文の英語説明だけですべての歴史的・感情的意味を伝えることはできませんでした。そこで本文には実用的な短い説明を置き、詳しく知りたい人向けの補足へつなげました。悠斗は、何を伝えるかだけでなく、いつ、どれだけ伝えるかもコミュニケーション設計の一部だと学びました。説明が多すぎれば必要な行動が埋もれ、少なすぎれば文化的意味が失われます。部では難しい翻訳判断と理由を記録するログも作り、新しい部員が過去の意図を理解できるようにしました。この記録は意図的な選択と単なる表現の揺れを区別する助けにもなり、後の編集を速く、より一貫したものにしました。

rv3-000123.passageAppend: When construction finally ended, the promised strip of land remained, but creating a complete public path required agreement with another landowner farther ahead. Ryo learned that being included in a plan was not the same as having a funded, permitted, and scheduled project. Long-term planning could preserve a possibility without guaranteeing immediate construction. Meanwhile, the temporary road changes continued to matter because temporary measures often remain in use longer than expected. The city reviewed the crossing again after six months and discovered that traffic patterns had shifted because of the new development. Signal timing was adjusted a second time. Ryo began to understand why planners talk about networks rather than isolated paths. A shortcut, a crossing, a housing project, school arrival times, and private property could overlap in one small piece of land, and a change in one part could alter several others.
rv3-000123.translationAppend: 工事終了後、将来の通路用地は残りましたが、公共道を最後まで完成させるには、その先にある別の土地の所有者との合意も必要でした。涼は、計画に載ることと、予算・許可・工期が確定して実現が約束されることは違うと学びました。長期計画は可能性を残せても、すぐの建設を保証しません。一方、暫定対策は予想以上に長く使われることもあるため、市は半年後に交差点を再調査しました。新しい開発で交通量が変わり、信号時間も再調整されました。涼は、近道、横断歩道、住宅開発、登校時刻、私有地などが小さな一地点で重なり、一つの変更が他にも影響するため、都市計画では個別の道ではなくネットワークとして考える必要があると理解しました。

rv3-000124.passageAppend: The club repeated measurements on several days and found another lesson: one successful afternoon was not enough evidence for a permanent rule. On cloudy days, the reflective shades made little difference; on bright days, they mattered much more. Fans were useful only when positioned to mix air rather than simply blow papers across desks. The students therefore recorded conditions together with the measurements instead of comparing averages without context. Their questions became more specific. Rather than asking, Do fans work, they asked, Under which conditions, in which rooms, and for which problem do fans help? The answers were less simple but more useful. Staff also kept brief notes about repeated complaints after each adjustment. This habit prevented them from treating every warm room as the same technical problem and made later adjustments faster. It also gave teachers a clearer record of which changes had already been tested.
rv3-000124.translationAppend: 部は複数の日に測定を繰り返し、一日の成功例だけでは恒久的なルールを決められないことも学びました。曇天では反射シェードの効果は小さく、晴天では大きくなりました。扇風機も、紙を飛ばすだけの向きではなく空気を混ぜる位置に置いたときに役立ちました。そこで平均値だけを比較するのではなく、その日の条件も一緒に記録しました。問いも『扇風機は効くか』から『どの条件、どの教室、どの問題に効くか』へ具体化しました。答えは単純ではなくなりましたが、実用性は高まりました。調整後の苦情も短く記録し、すべての暑い教室を同じ故障として扱わないようにしました。教師にとっても、すでに何を試したか確認しやすくなりました。
